test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The crowd of the migrant worker at the station for the Shramik Special is unforgettable.
solution:
The erroneous part is** of the migrant worker i.e. this part has an error.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Change **the migrant worker** to **the migrant workers**.
 
• The Collective noun **Crowd **represent the collection of **workers**, therefore plural form of noun should be used here.
 
• **Crowd**: a large number of people in one place.
 
 
• The **crowd **jeered when the boxer was knocked down.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__** Some of the Collective nouns:**__

 
• **Herd**– A group of herbivore animals
 
• **Pack**– A group of canine animals such as wolves or dogs; also used to describe playing cards and packages containing multiple objects
 
• **Flock**– A group of birds; also used to discuss small hooved animals such as sheep or goats
 
• **Swarm**– A group of insects
 
• **Shoal**– A group of fish
